semantic_actions.notes: Sensitive controls remain subject to platform lockscreen policy.
Security/lockscreen interception runs before ordinary navigation.
Actual brightness/timeout policy is separate and still undecided.
Waking a display does not grant unlock or reveal unredacted content.
Secondary-display content remains governed by its own privacy policy.

programmable_keys.notes: Default Sable command key. When locked/screen-off it may request primary-display wake, but the command action is suppressed until unlocked. User-remappable.
Default Sable attention key. May wake the primary display and open the notification surface subject to lockscreen redaction. User-remappable.

wake_policy.notes: Ordinary QWERTY/modifier keys do not wake the primary display by default. Explicit controls such as Power or assigned programmable keys may request wake. This avoids accidental wake/first-key ambiguity while preserving lockscreen security.

keyboard_touch_policy.notes: Default to pointer semantics for broad Android app compatibility. Gesture/Hybrid remain user-selectable; RAW_APP is an explicit per-app escape hatch.

keyboard_backlight_policy.notes: Default 50% user-facing brightness, illuminate on keyboard/touch-surface activity, turn off after 20 seconds of inactivity, and do not use the keyboard backlight for notifications. Settings may expose brightness/timeout within the bounded controller.

delegated_decisions.reason: KF2 may route a semantic request toward the rear display, but task hosting, notification presentation, privacy and product role are display/attention policy.
